newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street holds gains at midday.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street holds gains at midday.

text.p: Wall Street preserved its early-morning gains at midday Monday, rising to a new high on momentum from Friday's rally before pulling back a bit.
Analysts said a weaker dollar and lower long bond also dampened the gains that brought the Dow industrials to yet another high of 7511.53 earlier in the day.
At midday the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up about 62 points, or 0.84 percent, to 7498.
The Nasdaq composite also rose, up about 10 ponts to 1415.
Analysts said they expect investors to take profits but see the market holding steady for the remainder of the day.
"We're looking for the market to consolidate Friday's and Monday's gains," said Dan Ascani, president and director of research at Global Market Strategists Inc.
Tom Carpenter, a managing director and chief economist at ASB Capital Management Inc, said the morning gain was "well enough at this point."
"We had a good few days from Friday but we've had some deterioration in the long bond," Carpenter said.
